title: Resolution maps compute inflation in group cohomology
statement: Let $\pi\colon G'\to G$ be a surjective homomorphism of groups, and let $M$ be an abelian group with a $G$-action by automorphisms, regarded as a $G'$-module by $g' x=\pi(g')x$. Let $P_\bullet\xrightarrow{\varepsilon}\mathbf Z$ and $P'_\bullet\xrightarrow{\varepsilon'}\mathbf Z$ be projective resolutions of the trivial modules over $\mathbf Z[G]$ and $\mathbf Z[G']$, respectively: exact augmented nonnegative chain complexes [def-weil-pbc-module-chain-complex-homology] whose terms are projective (every module homomorphism from such a term lifts through any surjective module homomorphism). Write $\operatorname{Res}_{\pi}P_\bullet$ for $P_\bullet$ with the $G'$-action restricted along $\pi$. If $f\colon P'_\bullet\to\operatorname{Res}_{\pi}P_\bullet$ is a $\mathbf Z[G']$-linear chain map satisfying $\varepsilon\circ f_0=\varepsilon'$, then precomposition with $f$ induces, under the canonical projective-resolution identifications, the inflation map $H^s(G,M)\to H^s(G',M)$ for every $s\geq0$. Here $H^s(G,M)$ is the cohomology of the cochain complex of functions $G^q\to M$ with differential $(da)(g_1,\ldots,g_{q+1})=g_1a(g_2,\ldots,g_{q+1})+\sum_{j=1}^q(-1)^ja(g_1,\ldots,g_jg_{j+1},\ldots,g_{q+1})+(-1)^{q+1}a(g_1,\ldots,g_q)$, and inflation sends a cochain $a$ to $a\circ\pi^q$.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-bar-resolution-cochains] to $G$ and $G'$, obtaining the exact augmented projective resolutions $B=B(G)$ and $B'=B(G')$ and the evaluation identifications of their Hom complexes with the inhomogeneous group cochains. Write $\epsilon_B$ and $\epsilon_{B'}$ for their augmentations. Both resolve the same underlying trivial abelian group $\mathbf Z$ over their respective group rings.

source.place: Paragraph 3, “It computes inflation”; comparison and bar-resolution details supplied here, with the lifting argument of Stacks Tag 00LS (lemma-compare-resolutions).

proof.text: Let $\pi_R:\mathbf Z[G']\to\mathbf Z[G]$ be the ring map induced by $\pi$. On the free basis in [lem-sfb-bar-resolution-cochains], define $b_n:B'_n\to\operatorname{Res}_\pi B_n$ by $b_n(a[g'_1|\cdots|g'_n])=\pi_R(a)[\pi(g'_1)|\cdots|\pi(g'_n)]$. This is $\mathbf Z[G']$-linear. Each term in the displayed bar differential is preserved: $\pi(g'_1g'_2)=\pi(g'_1)\pi(g'_2)$ and $\pi_R(g')=\pi(g')$, while the signs are unchanged. Thus $d_B b=b d_{B'}$; in degree zero the sum of coefficients is preserved, giving $\epsilon_B b_0=\epsilon_{B'}$. Under evaluation, precomposition by $b_n$ sends $c$ to $c\circ\pi^n$, exactly the inflation cochain map.

proof.text: By [lem-sfb-projective-resolution-homotopy-equivalence], with $R=\mathbf Z[G]$ and $T=\mathbf Z$, choose augmentation preserving chain homotopy inverse maps $u:P\to B$ and $v:B\to P$. Apply the same node over $\mathbf Z[G']$ to choose $u':P'\to B'$ and $v':B'\to P'$. The bar complexes have the required projectivity and augmented exactness by [lem-sfb-bar-resolution-cochains], and $P,P'$ have them by hypothesis. No restriction-of-scalars functor is used in these applications.

source.place: Paragraph 3, “It computes inflation”; comparison and bar-resolution details supplied here, with the lifting argument of Stacks Tag 00LS (lemma-compare-resolutions).

proof.text: Here is the elementary effect of a chain homotopy on Hom cohomology. If $a-a'=d_K h+h d_L$ for maps $L\to K$, and $z:K_s\to M$ is a cocycle, then $z(a_s-a'_s)=z d^K_{s+1}h_s+z h_{s-1}d^L_s=(z h_{s-1})d^L_s$, a coboundary; for $s=0$ it is zero because $h_{-1}=0$. Applying this calculation to the homotopy inverse equations supplied by [lem-sfb-projective-resolution-homotopy-equivalence] shows that precomposition $u^*:H^s\operatorname{Hom}_G(B,M)\to H^s\operatorname{Hom}_G(P,M)$ is an isomorphism with inverse $v^*$, and likewise for $u',v'$.

source.place: Paragraph 3, “It computes inflation”; comparison and bar-resolution details supplied here, with the lifting argument of Stacks Tag 00LS (lemma-compare-resolutions).

proof.text: These identifications are canonical: any two augmentation preserving maps $P\to B$ are homotopic by [new-t4-augmented-resolution-lift-homotopy], applied in $\mathbf Z[G]$-modules with source $P$ and target $B$, and hence induce the same Hom cohomology map by Step 4. The same applies over $\mathbf Z[G']$. To check the categorical hypotheses explicitly, kernels and cokernels of module maps carry the induced $R$-actions. For an $R$-linear map $t:X\to Y$, the coimage-to-image map $X/\ker t\to\operatorname{im}t$, $[x]\mapsto t(x)$, is a well-defined bijection and is $R$-linear since $t(rx)=rt(x)$; its inverse is therefore $R$-linear. Together with the zero module and finite direct sums, these constructions verify that the category of left modules over either group ring is abelian. Epimorphisms are exactly surjections: a nonsurjective map has a nonzero quotient cokernel, whose quotient map and zero map witness failure to be an epimorphism; a surjection is right cancellable on elements. Thus the module lifting property in the hypotheses is also categorical projectivity. Exactness at $B_0$ and every $B_n$ is given by [lem-sfb-bar-resolution-cochains], and the degree-zero augmentation composite with $d_1$ is zero because it is an augmented chain complex. Projectivity of the source terms is part of the hypotheses on $P,P'$. Thus the isomorphisms in Step 4, composed with Step 1's evaluation maps, are precisely the canonical projective-resolution identifications in the statement.

source.place: Paragraph 3, “It computes inflation”; comparison and bar-resolution details supplied here, with the lifting argument of Stacks Tag 00LS (lemma-compare-resolutions).

proof.text: Consider $A=(\operatorname{Res}_\pi u)\circ f$ and $A'=b\circ u'$ from $P'$ to $\operatorname{Res}_\pi B$. They are $\mathbf Z[G']$-linear chain maps and $\epsilon_B A_0=\epsilon f_0=\epsilon'$, while $\epsilon_B A'_0=\epsilon_{B'}u'_0=\epsilon'$. Restricting the action leaves the underlying groups, differentials, kernels and images unchanged, so the augmented target $\operatorname{Res}_\pi B$ remains exact by [lem-sfb-bar-resolution-cochains]. Apply [new-t4-augmented-resolution-lift-homotopy] with source $P'$ and this exact target: its statement requires projectivity only of the source, which holds by hypothesis. We obtain a $\mathbf Z[G']$-linear homotopy $A-A'=d_Bh+h d_{P'}$. In particular no projectivity of $\operatorname{Res}_\pi B$ or $\operatorname{Res}_\pi P$ is assumed.

source.place: Paragraph 3, “It computes inflation”; comparison and bar-resolution details supplied here, with the lifting argument of Stacks Tag 00LS (lemma-compare-resolutions).

proof.text: For a $G$-linear cocycle $z:B_s\to M$, restriction makes $z$ a $G'$-linear cocycle. The homotopy from Step 6 gives $z u_s f_s-z b_s u'_s=(z h_{s-1})d^{P'}_s$, with zero difference for $s=0$, by Step 4. Thus on cohomology $f^*u^*=(u')^*b^*$. Step 2 identifies $b^*$ with inflation on group cochains, and Steps 4–5 identify $u^*$ and $(u')^*$ with the canonical projective-resolution isomorphisms. Conjugating this equality by those isomorphisms proves that precomposition by the given $f$ induces inflation for every $s\geq0$.
